title.zh: 将拉乌尼翁省 Burgos 市镇 Upper Tumapoc 描笼涯的 Burgos 国立中学的 Upper Tumapoc 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Burgos National High School - Upper Tumapoc Annex in Barangay Upper Tumapoc, Municipality of Burgos, Province of La Union From the Burgos National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Upper Tumapoc National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Upper Tumapoc của Trường Trung học Burgos Quốc gia tại Barangay Upper Tumapoc, Đô thị Burgos, Tỉnh La Union khỏi Trường Trung học Burgos Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Upper Tumapoc Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Upper Tumapoc ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Burgos แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Upper Tumapoc เทศบาล Burgos จังหวัด La Union ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Burgos แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Upper Tumapoc แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Upper Tumapoc, Sekolah Menengah Burgos Nasional di Barangay Upper Tumapoc, Kotamadya Burgos, Provinsi La Union dari Sekolah Menengah Burgos Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Upper Tumapoc Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Upper Tumapoc, Sekolah Menengah Burgos Kebangsaan di Barangay Upper Tumapoc, Perbandaran Burgos, Wilayah La Union daripada Sekolah Menengah Burgos Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Upper Tumapoc Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Burgos National High School – Upper Tumapoc Annex in Barangay Upper Tumapoc, Municipality of Burgos, Province of La Union is hereby separated from the Burgos National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Upper Tumapoc National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Burgos National High School – Upper Tumapoc Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Upper Tumapoc National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Upper Tumapoc National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Burgos National High School – Upper Tumapoc Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
